_comment: Per-rule ceiling for `ruff --select F` over app/, enforced by
scripts/check_ruff_gate.py in deploy.yml. A count may FALL, never rise.
Fix findings and ratchet the number down in the same change; do not raise a
number to make a build pass. Same contract as the platform repo's
F821 (undefined name) and invalid-syntax are NOT listed here on purpose: they
are enforced at zero by ZERO_TOLERANCE in the gate script. F821 was 41 across
app/ before this work — it covered a search path that never searched, six
pipeline endpoints that always 500'd, and four modules using an unimported
module. It is 0 now and must stay 0.
The rules below are hygiene debt, not broken code: unused imports (F401),
f-strings with no placeholders (F541), unused locals (F841), star-import
fallout (F403/F405), redefinitions (F811). F811 is the one worth attacking
first — a redefinition silently discards the earlier definition.
